title: Marc Jacobs perfume: Perfect, Daisy, Honey and the mini set compared
body:
Marc Jacobs fragrances are playful and easy to wear: fruity tops, soft florals and gentle, musky or woody bases. The house's two big families are Perfect and Daisy, with Honey as a warmer, sweeter choice. Here is every Marc Jacobs perfume we stock, with its notes and who each one suits.

Marc Jacobs Perfect: three strengths

Perfect is built around rhubarb and narcissus, and each version takes it in a different direction:

  • Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum (50ml): rhubarb and narcissus, then almond milk, over cedarwood and cashmeran. Soft, creamy and a little nutty, an easy everyday scent.
  • Perfect Eau de Toilette (10ml miniature): rhubarb and pink pepper, then narcissus, over cedarwood. Lighter and brighter, with no almond milk.
  • Perfect Elixir Eau de Parfum (10ml miniature): plum and rhubarb, then a floral accord, over vanilla, amber and woods. The warmest of the three, for evenings and winter.

Which Perfect? The eau de parfum for a soft, creamy floral; the eau de toilette for something fresher; the Elixir for a sweeter, ambery version.

Daisy Love and Daisy Love Glow

  • Daisy Love Eau de Toilette (10ml miniature): cloudberry, then daisy, over cashmere musk and driftwood. Light, fruity and clean, a daytime scent.
  • Daisy Love Glow Limited Edition Eau de Toilette (50ml): lemon essential oil, cloudberry and bergamot, then clove essential oil, jasmine and lemon blossom, over cashmere musk and patchouli oil. Brighter at the top and a touch spicier in the heart.

Marc Jacobs Honey

Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum (100ml) is the sweetest Marc Jacobs we stock: pear, mandarin and a punch accord, then honeysuckle, orange blossom and peach, over honey, vanilla and woods. Warm and fruity, a good choice for anyone who finds Daisy too light.

The Marc Jacobs miniature set

The Marc Jacobs Women's Miniature Fragrance Gift Set 2025 is the easiest way to try the Daisy family:

  • Daisy Eau de Toilette (4ml): strawberry, violet leaf and grapefruit; violet, gardenia and jasmine; musk, white woods and vanilla.
  • Daisy Eau So Fresh (4ml): raspberry, grapefruit and pear; violet, rose and apple blossom; musk, cedar and plum.
  • Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum (4ml): banana blossom; jasmine and macadamia; vetiver and sandalwood.
  • Perfect Eau de Parfum (5ml).

Which Marc Jacobs perfume should you choose?

  • A soft, creamy everyday floral: Perfect Eau de Parfum.
  • Something warmer for evenings: Perfect Elixir.
  • Light and fruity: Daisy Love.
  • Bright with a little spice: Daisy Love Glow.
  • Sweet and warm: Honey.
  • Not sure yet: the miniature set, or one of the 10ml sprays.

If you like Daisy's fruity florals, Lalique Amethyst Éclat Eau de Parfum (100ml) pairs raspberry, blackcurrant and pear with peony, rose and magnolia over blackberry, musk and violet woodsorrel. It is a different perfume, with more berries.

Good to know

  • Eau de parfum or eau de toilette? Our guide to extrait vs eau de parfum explains the labels.
  • Buying a gift? See our mini perfume sets guide and perfume gift sets guide.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.
